subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: After inspecting the two failed jobs, can the unchanged artifact safely be requeued now, or must the scanner-state defect be repaired before any result is written back?
rationale: VirusTotal is explicitly non-authoritative telemetry, so the completed verdict cannot be reconstructed safely without production-job evidence or a successful ClawScan rerun.

options.title: Inspect and requeue
options.body: Verify the failed job state, requeue the unchanged artifact through the normal worker, and persist only the resulting verified verdict.

options.title: Repair state handling first
options.body: If the same failure is reproducible, fix and validate the VirusTotal-to-ClawScan state transition before reprocessing this artifact.

options.title: Keep the result unresolved
options.body: Retain the error state and explain it to the publisher if the job provenance cannot be verified safely.

recommendation.title: Inspect and requeue
recommendation.body: Verify the failed job state, requeue the unchanged artifact through the normal worker, and persist only the resulting verified verdict.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most directly connects this contributor to security-scan worker execution and repair behavior.
